lines: Of desirer of enjoyment or of desirer of liberation or, from own consciousness guru scripture by authority which, for purification initiation indeed by guru done.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bubhukṣorvā mumukṣorvā svasaṃvidguruśāstrataḥ pramāṇādyā saṃskriyāyai dīkṣā hi guruṇā kṛtā
